integrity: The proof is analytic. CHECKER.py provides reproducible finite tests but is not an infinite certificate. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only D-optimal evaluation determinant within each fixed height-order chamber is classified; no global best permutation is specified.
No spectral condition-number or reconstruction-error bound follows from a determinant alone.
The prior order-by-order Fourier analysis is classical; an older implicit weighted-Fekete formulation might already yield the product or strict-concavity result.
title: All-bandwidth determinant factorization and chamber-unique spherical ring designs
